This is my rice plot near the lake, and I have been farming here for many years. Rice needs good water and good weeding, so I must plan carefully. I will put a little fertilizer — one bag of urea if I can manage — because rice responds well, but I cannot afford more than that. For seed I will use what I saved from last year; the improved seed is expensive and not always easy to find in the market here. I will call some neighbors to help with transplanting and weeding because my family alone cannot finish on time.
